2608.07285.title: How Much AI Is in This Track? Quantifying the Proportion of AI-Generated Stems in Hybrid Music Mixtures
2608.07285.paper_summary: AI-generated music is increasingly used at the stem level, with producers integrating synthetic drums, basslines, or vocals alongside human-performed instruments. However, current AI music detection systems are binary, treating tracks as either fully AI or fully human. In this paper, we reformulate AI music detection as a regression problem on a continuous AI energy ratio, alpha in [0, 1]. We propose a methodology that leverages a multi-track music dataset to assemble mixtures of human-performed and AI-reconstructed stems (obtained using a neural audio codec) with known proportions of each content type. Using this approach, we first show that a CNN-based model trained on fully AI-generated or human-performed tracks, which achieves >99% accuracy as a binary detector, when faced with mixed content, yields an output that rises with the AI stems' energy contribution, acting as a noisy and miscalibrated estimator. Our analysis of the influence of different stems shows that detection sensitivity depends on the instrument and reflects its frequency content: drums and guitar carry strong codec-artifact signatures, while vocals and bass are less detectable. Based on these insights, we train a similar CNN-based model for regression of alpha, achieving MAE = 0.076 and R^2 = 0.85 on held-out mixtures from the same pipeline. These results suggest that the regression formulation is an initial promising step towards AI-music detection in realistic music production workflows.
2608.07285.paper_summary_zh: AI 生成的音樂在 STEM 層面上越來越多地被使用，製作人將合成鼓、貝斯線或人聲與人類演奏的樂器結合在一起。<lb/>然而，目前的 AI 音樂檢測系統是二元的，將音軌視為完全 AI 或完全人類。<lb/>在本文中，我們將 AI 音樂檢測重新表述為一個關於連續 AI 能量比的回歸問題，alpha 在 [0, 1] 之間。<lb/>我們提出了一種方法論，利用多軌音樂數據集來組合人類演奏和 AI 重建的音軌混合（通過神經音頻編解碼器獲得），並具有已知的每種內容類型的比例。<lb/>使用這種方法，我們首先顯示出一個基於 CNN 的模型，該模型在完全 AI 生成或人類演奏的音軌上訓練，作為二元檢測器達到 >99% 的準確率，當面對混合內容時，輸出隨著 AI 音軌的能量貢獻而上升，充當一個嘈雜且未經校準的估計器。<lb/>我們對不同音軌影響的分析顯示，檢測靈敏度取決於樂器並反映其頻率內容：鼓和吉他帶有強烈的編解碼器伪影特徵，而人聲和貝斯則較不易檢測。<lb/>基於這些見解，我們訓練了一個類似的基於 CNN 的模型來回歸 alpha，在來自同一管道的保留混合上達到 MAE = 0.076 和 R^2 = 0.85。<lb/>這些結果表明，回歸表述是朝著在現實音樂製作工作流程中進行 AI 音樂檢測的一個初步有希望的步驟。
